molecule.geometry_method: symmetric planar equilibrium-like geometry; configurable O-H length and H-O-H angle

full_space_fci.method: PySCF full-space FCI in the closed-shell (5 alpha, 5 beta) sector

active_space.selection: HOMO-1, HOMO, LUMO, LUMO+1 from the RHF orbital ordering
active_space.justification: Compact valence-active prototype; excludes the three lowest doubly occupied orbitals, including the oxygen 1s core. Not a chemically complete water model.

exact_reference.method: PySCF CASCI exact diagonalization in the selected 4e/4o (2 alpha, 2 beta) sector
exact_reference.hamiltonian_scope: selected active-space Hamiltonian with frozen-orbital contributions

resource_estimates.method: qubit-count and statevector dimension estimates; excludes PySCF integral/SCF memory

full_system.pauli_terms_note: Measured after full Jordan-Wigner mapping and reported in full_system; not estimated here.

warnings: Full-space RHF/FCI and active-space energies are different references; only compare VQE with the active-space exact reference.
The configured active space is a compact exploratory model and omits frozen valence correlation.
Statevector estimates do not model PySCF memory use or IBM hardware noise.
